subject: Urgent: M8r latency surge — containment & temporary routing request
messages:
From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@finsecure.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Hi Markus,

We're seeing a sustained latency spike on calls served by model variant M8r starting ~07:40 PDT. 95th percentile token latency has climbed from our normal ~110ms to >900ms for the last 20 minutes and several of our payment flows are timing out. This is happening across multiple regions but most pronounced for US-west.

Quick facts:
- Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (model=M8r)
- P95 (1m sliding): 920ms (normally ~110ms)
- Error counts: 502s small but timeouts are visible in our checkout flows
- Client impact: increased checkout failures, customers experiencing double-charges in some retries (we've throttled retries)

We need a containment plan ASAP (routing fallback, pin to prior variant, or throttling guidance). Can you advise immediate mitigations? If you need more traces, I attached a short CSV with sample request timings.

Sophie
Sophie Lemaire
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, FinSecure

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@finsecure.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Thanks Sophie — we see the same signal in our telemetry. I pulled server-side traces; attaching a tarball with the top hot paths (m8r-traces-0605.tar.gz) and a CSV of p95 snapshots.

Immediate containment proposal (short window, low risk):
1) Route FinSecure traffic away from M8r to M8r-compat (a lightly quantized, identical-API variant) for an initial 2-hour window.
2) If M8r-compat is not stable, pin the account to last known-good model M7x (minimal functional delta).
3) Enable a short, capacity-backed burst pool for FinSecure for the next 4 hours to avoid further timeouts (we'd absorb cost and track).
4) We request a temporary SLA grace window for FinSecure for the 48 hours following the incident to avoid automatic SLA credit triggers while we complete the root-cause analysis.

Before we action: need explicit approval from FinSecure for the routing change (side effects: slight tokenization diff possible, small output variance) and an internal approval for the SLA carveout. Please confirm.

Markus Klein
Director, Customer Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: latency-snapshots-0605.csv, m8r-traces-0605.tar.gz

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@finsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Markus / Sophie — quick analysis: the KV cache hot-shard on the M8r serving cluster appears overloaded due to a shift in prefix distribution from a customer-side burst. It's producing disproportionate kernel queuing under usual batching heuristics.

Risk assessment:
- Rolling pin to M7x: low risk for correctness, medium work for re-tokenization/compat checks (we have quick tests).
- Route to M8r-compat: medium risk for latency improvement but might surface minor scoring differences in edge prompts.

I recommend: route to M8r-compat immediately for 2 hours, open an automated traffic circuit that reverts if p95 > 500ms for 10m. If that stabilizes, keep in compat and run deeper RCA.

I'll prepare the rollout job and the quick compatibility smoke tests. Neha, can you provision the burst pool and prepare the rollback playbook?

Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: m8r-hotshard-analysis.txt

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Thanks team — approve the proposed containment plan with the following conditions:
- Approve: immediate routing to M8r-compat for FinSecure + burst pool for 4 hours.
- Approve: a one-time 48-hour SLA grace for FinSecure tied to this incident (we will log the carveout and communicate to Finance).
- Condition: require automatic rollback if p95 remains > 500ms for a continuous 10-minute window, and a post-mortem within 72 hours that includes customer impact and mitigation steps.

Markus, please coordinate the comment and send the MAP_draft_finsecure_v2.pdf for Sophie to confirm.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@finsecure.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2027 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Actioned: routing rule applied at 10:46 PDT — FinSecure traffic moved to M8r-compat and burst pool assigned.
Initial telemetry (10:50 PDT): p50 ~ 78ms, p95 ~ 280ms (improvement). Will monitor for the next 2 hours and keep the automated rollback policy engaged (threshold p95 > 500ms for 10m).

Change log: routing-change-log-0605.txt

Neha Kapoor
Lead Production Ops
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sophie Lemaire <sophie.lemaire@finsecure.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: M8r: sustained API latency spike impacting payment flows

Markus / team — thanks for the quick response and the temporary routing. Traffic has been stable since the change; we've seen p95 back down into the 200–300ms band and checkout failures have returned to baseline.

We do want the post-mortem and the MAP that Grace mentioned; I attached a short list of customer-impact bullet points and a request for a deeper RCA. We'll take the MAP draft and review internally.

Sophie

Attachments referenced in thread: latency-snapshots-0605.csv, m8r-traces-0605.tar.gz, m8r-hotshard-analysis.txt, routing-change-log-0605.txt, MAP_draft_finsecure_v2.pdf
